goal: Prevent transaction origin deanonymization by isolating private broadcasts completely from node state
Eliminate IP address linkage risks caused by coupling private broadcasts to the main connection manager
reviewability: Needs a mechanical rebase against master
agreement: Strong support for in-tree isolation to stop state correlation leaks and protect origin privacy (darosior)
Unanswered objection: permanent reliance on centralized DNS seeds risks censorship or outages (vasild)
Unanswered objection: broadcasting only over Tor to IP peers is fragile and worsens network privacy (vasild)
Suggested deprecating in-node broadcast entirely in favor of lightweight external hooks (ajtowns)
Questioned sourcing peers from DNS seeds and dropping direct Tor and I2P connections (andrewtoth)

categories.name: p2p
why: P1 because it addresses severe transaction origin deanonymization and IP linkage risks in peer networking
The current coupled broadcast implementation acts as a footgun that leaks privacy under adversarial probing
